d: What makes a senior cricketer consider his own future if his captain is removed? Josh Hazlewood's comments have put Pat Cummins' leadership at the centre of the latest Sandpaper Gate controversy. With Cameron Bancroft's allegations bringing fresh scrutiny to Australia's 2018 ball-tampering scandal, Hazlewood has stood firmly behind Cummins and his record as captain. Rupha Ramani dives deep into the relationship between the two Australian fast bowlers, Cummins' leadership and the changing culture of Australian cricket.
